summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Volatility Shares Cardano ETF (CRDD) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long ada, short usd currency. The fund is an actively managed fund, offering price participation in ADA, the native token of the Cardano network, using near-term futures and ADA-related instruments. CRDD was launched on Apr 1, 2026 and is issued by Volatility Shares.
